c.n: A family restaurant group built on hospitality first. Three restaurants, one family, and a standard that started in 2004.
c.s: A family restaurant group built on hospitality first. Three restaurants, one family, and a standard that started in 2004.

c.n: In 2004, after more than two decades in some of Metro Detroit’s most respected kitchens, Chef Jeff Baldwin and Rosemarie Baldwin opened J.Baldwin’s in Clinton Township. The idea: fine-dining flavor and technique in a room that feels welcoming.
c.s: In 2004, after more than two decades in some of Metro Detroit’s most respected kitchens, Chef Jeff Baldwin and Rosemarie Baldwin opened J.Baldwin’s in Clinton Township. The idea: fine-dining flavor and technique in a room that feels welcoming.

c.n: It grew into a true family business. Testa Barra followed in Macomb Township, and The Baldwin is next, carrying the same values: hospitality, consistency and bringing people together.
